name: Candace
title: Queen of Ethiopia
summary: Candace was the title of the queen of Ethiopia. Her powerful court official, who had charge of her entire treasury, was on his way home from Jerusalem when Philip preached the gospel to him and baptized him.

keyEvents.title: Her Court Official Is Baptized
keyEvents.description: The court official of Queen Candace, who was in charge of her entire treasury, was taught and baptized by Philip on the road from Jerusalem.
